verdict.rationale: Buzz is a team-chat product, so incoming webhooks are a fair axis. The evidence pack never documents an incoming webhook URL for posting into a channel. Programmatic posting is only shown through the Buzz CLI, signed Nostr events over NIP-29/NIP-42, and the ACP agent harness. Those are different, key-signed mechanisms, not a simple webhook URL, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can post a message into a channel with a simple incoming webhook URL
